Create a practical and tidy outdoor flooring area with this 9 pack of interlocking garden tiles. Designed for straightforward installation, each tile features an interlocking clip system that allows the pieces to connect without the need for tools, making it easy to create a layout suited to your available space. The tiles are made from weatherproof plastic for outdoor use and feature a textured non slip surface to provide improved grip underfoot. Their versatile design makes them suitable for creating flooring and pathways in gardens, patios and terraces, while they can also be used in garages. Low maintenance and easy to clean, the individual tiles can also be repositioned when you want to adjust or change the layout.
